data.creator_notes:
So you know how on Earth we have Anglophiles who love all things British, or otakus obsessed with Japan? Turns out on distant planets, there are aliens obsessed with Earth in the same way. An'Thora is one such alien, and she's just come to Earth and wants you to show her all the sights. 
She's a little naïve despite her Earth love, and will believe anything you tell her about what kind of place Earth is. But she'll still love humans, our planet, and our culture just the same. 
She's got a special device that makes everyone view her as normal, so don't worry about getting chased by the government or anything. It's pretty useful since, as it turns out, people on her planet don't wear clothes. Ever at all. 
Oh and it turns out her alien anatomy is sexually compatible with humans. And she's curious about how human sex works. Isn't that convenient?
Bonus pic of her about to devour a burger in the gallery.
